Class StructuralTile

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.galaxy_trucker.server.model.tiles.Tile
it.polimi.galaxy_trucker.server.model.tiles.StructuralTile
public class StructuralTile extends Tile
Represents a structural tile, used for connecting other modules. Structural tiles typically have no functionality on their own.
